mode: dark only: the whole game is set after moonrise. A light variant would be 'dawn', not designed here.
contrast_note: WCAG ratios computed with the standard relative-luminance formula. Body text is moonink or mist on night/canopy/slab; numerals on stat badges are night ink on the badge colour.

colours.name: night
colours.use: page background, deepest shadow; dark ink for numerals on badges

colours.name: bark-line
colours.use: dividers, empty-slot fill, inactive borders (never text)

colours.name: moonink
colours.use: primary text and the pale ink lines of frames and icons

colours.name: mist
colours.use: secondary text: type lines, labels, slot names

colours.name: glowcap
colours.use: bioluminescent fungus: selection, focus, keywords in rules text, positive changes, End Turn

colours.name: lantern
colours.use: golden (tripled) unit frame, with firefly sparkles

colours.name: rosehip
colours.use: health badge, damage numbers, negative changes, player health in the lobby

colours.name: nightshade
colours.use: the Nightshade status: berry badge, violet aura, the halving number; also Fairies' tribe accent

colours.name: hoarfrost
colours.use: Freeze: the frozen shop card's rime overlay and the freeze button; Birds' tribe accent

colours.name: lichen
colours.use: tribe accent for Hedgerow folk and Bog folk; tier pips on the moon badge

glow_rule: Only living, active things glow: gold, the selected card, the next opponent, statuses. Everything else is flat pale ink on dark. Glows are a soft outer shadow of the colour at 35-60% alpha, never a gradient fill.
